packageRules.description: The BepInEx packages and the game's assemblies come from the BepInEx feed; the project adds it with RestoreAdditionalProjectSources.
Must match the game's Unity version, so it's changed by hand when a game update moves to a new Unity.
Must match the installed game, so updates wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard. Its versions are all prereleases (e.g. 1.5.0-r.1).
